summary: Verified new Email Settings (SMTP) admin feature end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 pytest passed covering access control, masked GET, save/update, blank-password preservation, forgot-password dry-run wiring, and regression on public/theme/settings endpoints. Frontend: admin sees 'Email' tab; form fields, hint, save toast, persistence and password-blank-on-load all verified. DRY RUN log confirmed in backend logs.
critical_code_review_comments: utils/smtp.py encryption key fallback derives from JWT_SECRET — acceptable but ensure APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY is set in production (currently set in backend/.env).
Frontend EmailSettingsTab uses autoComplete='new-password' — good against browser autofill of the stored SMTP password.
Backend PUT does not validate that from_email looks like an email or smtp_port is in a sensible range; consider Pydantic EmailStr / conint validation.
forgot_password endpoint still prints reset link + SMTP status via print(); acceptable for dev but should be gated by debug flag in production.
test_credentials: admin@example.com / admin123 (super_admin). No non-admin (acme@client.com) seeded in this environment — the 403 test skipped for that user; instead unauthenticated GET/PUT correctly return 401/403.
seed_data_creation: SMTP settings row written to app_settings (key=smtp_settings) with host smtp.mailtrap.io:2525, username mailer@company.com, from no-reply@company.com, encrypted password preserved from original save.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Email SMTP settings live under GET/PUT /api/settings/email (admin only). Password never returned. Blank password on PUT preserves existing encrypted password. Forgot-password uses send_password_reset_email(..., dry_run=True) — check backend logs for 'DRY RUN: reset email prepared ... via <host>' line to confirm wiring. Client-only test user acme@client.com was not present; unauthenticated 401/403 covers access control.
